verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה עֵץ־ הַגֶּ֖פֶן מִכָּל־ עֵ֑ץ הַזְּמוֹרָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בַּעֲצֵ֥י הַיָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām mah- yih·yeh ‘êṣ- hag·ge·p̄en mik·kāl ‘êṣ haz·zə·mō·w·rāh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ba·‘ă·ṣê hay·yā·‘ar
verses.literal: Son of man how does the wood of the vine surpass any other branch among the trees - in the forest
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, que mais é a árvore da videira do que qualquer outra árvore, ou do que o sarmento que está entre as árvores do bosque?

verses.original: הֲיֻקַּ֤ח מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עֵ֔ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אִם־ יִקְח֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ יָתֵ֔ד לִתְל֥וֹת עָלָ֖יו כָּל־ כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yuq·qaḥ mim·men·nū ‘êṣ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lim·lā·ḵāh ’im- yiq·ḥū mim·men·nū yā·ṯêḏ liṯ·lō·wṯ ‘ā·lāw kāl- ke·lî
verses.literal: Can wood be taken from it to make something useful Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang utensils
verses.literalPt: Toma-se dela madeira para fazer alguma obra? Ou toma-se dela alguma estaca, para que se lhe pendure um vaso?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לָאֵ֖שׁ נִתַּ֣ן לְאָכְלָ֑ה אֵת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י קְצוֹתָ֜יו אָכְלָ֤ה הָאֵשׁ֙ וְתוֹכ֣וֹ נָחָ֔ר הֲיִצְלַ֖ח לִמְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh lā·’êš nit·tan lə·’āḵ·lāh ’êṯ šə·nê qə·ṣō·w·ṯāw ’ā·ḵə·lāh hā·’êš wə·ṯō·w·ḵōw nā·ḥār hă·yiṣ·laḥ lim·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: No it is cast into the fire for fuel The fire devours both ends and the middle is charred Can it be useful for anything
verses.literalPt: Eis que é lançado no fogo, para ser consumido; ambas as suas extremidades consome o fogo, e o meio dela fica também queimado; serviria porventura para alguma obra?

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ בִּֽהְיוֹת֣וֹ תָמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יֵֽעָשֶׂ֖ה לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אַ֣ף כִּי־ אֵ֤שׁ אֲכָלַ֙תְהוּ֙ וַיֵּחָ֔ר וְנַעֲשָׂ֥ה ע֖וֹד לִמְלָאכָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh bih·yō·w·ṯōw ṯā·mîm lō yê·‘ā·śeh lim·lā·ḵāh ’ap̄ kî- ’êš ’ă·ḵā·laṯ·hū way·yê·ḥār wə·na·‘ă·śāh ‘ō·wḏ lim·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: Even when it was whole it could not be made useful How much less can it ever be useful when the fire has consumed it and charred it
verses.literalPt: Ora, se estando inteiro, não servia para obra alguma, quanto menos sendo consumido pelo fogo, e, sendo queimado, se faria ainda obra dele?

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עֵץ־ הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בְּעֵ֣ץ הַיַּ֔עַר אֲשֶׁר־ נְתַתִּ֥יו לָאֵ֖שׁ לְאָכְלָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן נָתַ֔תִּי אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ‘êṣ- hag·ge·p̄en bə·‘êṣ hay·ya·‘ar ’ă·šer- nə·ṯat·tîw lā·’êš lə·’āḵ·lāh kên nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest which I have given to the fire for fuel so I will give up the people of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Como a árvore da videira entre as árvores do bosque, que tenho entregue ao fogo para que seja consumido, assim entregarei os habitantes de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם מֵהָאֵ֣שׁ יָצָ֔אוּ וְהָאֵ֖שׁ תֹּֽאכְלֵ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּשׂוּמִ֥י אֶת־ פָּנַ֖י בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- pā·nay bā·hem mê·hā·’êš yā·ṣā·’ū wə·hā·’êš tō·ḵə·lêm wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·śū·mî ’eṯ- pā·nay bā·hem
verses.literal: And I will set My face against them Though they may have escaped the fire yet another fire will consume them And when I set My face against them you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: E porei a minha face contra eles; do fogo sairão, mas o fogo os consumirá; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando tiver posto a minha face contra eles.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֑ה יַ֚עַן מָ֣עֲלוּ מַ֔עַל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh ya·‘an mā·‘ă·lū ma·‘al nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus I will make the land desolate because they have acted unfaithfully . . . declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: E tornarei a terra em desolação, porquanto grandemente transgrediram, diz o Senhor DEUS.
